name: The Cliff
design_intent:
THE CLIFF — the asymmetric-spawn-tension level (v1_level_circuit.md §L-8, build order #4). A LOPSIDED landscape: ONE large safe mesa on the LEFT, then a scatter of small stepping-pads over a WIDE void filling the right two-thirds, stepping out to an exposed far ledge that bears the prize powerup. Kill identity = knock rivals OFF the mesa / OFF the scatter pads into the bottom blast void -> off the screen. Kill-shape class = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%, uncredited self-falls <= 12%) per docs/specs/v2a_kill_shape_void_floor_addendum.md §3, NOT the central_pit K1 edge/pit ratio; a high void/pit share here is the fantasy working, not a regression.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT FROM the four prior shipped levels: islands_void is an EVEN, mirror-balanced archipelago of four WIDE 960px islands (a symmetric farm); the_spine is ONE thin exposed ridge over a void on all sides (symmetric max-exposure); twin_chasms is a TWO-void split with a hot-seat centre (symmetric-mirrored); drop_chamber is an enclosed bumper drum. The Cliff is NONE of those — its signature is ASYMMETRY: the LEFT third is a single 1400px trampoline mesa (a big, forgiving, near-safe landing / farm), while the RIGHT two-thirds is a field of THREE smaller 680px pads over open void, each a boost-commit apart, terminating in an exposed far ledge. The two ends confer DIFFERENT risk (the flagship counter-point 'is the circuit all symmetric?'): spawn/hold the mesa and you are relatively safe but starved of the far powerup; venture right onto the scatter to contest the prize and every pad is a narrow perch over the maw with far less landing runway than the mesa. idle_hunt (Tuning.idle_hunt_after = 4.0) forbids camping the mesa, and the far-ledge powerup + throne PULL players rightward out over the void where the kills happen -> natural aggressor(right)/defender(mesa) dynamics.

GEOMETRY PASS (whiff-fall fix, GEOMETRY ONLY — no Tuning constant touched, fence per v1_level_circuit.md §6): a first pass used 400px right-scatter pads; a 13-stage 4-bot QA measured 100% off-screen kills BUT ~26% UNCREDITED self-falls (8/10 were 'void' whiffs at vx ~2400-4800 on the right scatter) — bots overshooting/undershooting the razor 400px pads into the void, breaching K1'b (<= 12%). This is exactly the flagship's narrow-island lesson (islands_void v3 widened 520-640px -> 960px for the same reason). FIX: the three right-scatter pads are WIDENED from 400px to 680px (still ~half the 1400 mesa, so they still read as the 'small scatter' identity, but now give real landing margin so a boosted crossing lands instead of whiffing into the void). Gaps stay the flagship-validated 580px (still FLIGHT-REQUIRED). No lethality/feel constant touched.

ENGINE RISK: NONE new. Reuses the islands-over-void static-geometry physics + the pit_void_rendering void treatment (paint_void draws the chasm fill/dirt walls/rim chevrons; _paint_void_gaps carves each gap between the floating surfaces into a canyon maw flush with each cliff). No new primitive.

GEOMETRY: LEFT MESA (safe farm, WIDE trampoline, x0..1400, top y1080, h128). GAP1 x1400..1980 = 580px void. PAD1 (bubblegum, x1980..2660 = 680px, top y1040, h112). GAP2 x2660..3240 = 580px. PAD2 (bubblegum, x3240..3920 = 680px, top y1000, h112). GAP3 x3920..4500 = 580px. FAR LEDGE (exposed prize shelf, trampoline, x4500..5180 = 680px, top y1060, h120) bearing the far powerup. One SPRING THRONE (x2780..3140, top y520, h48) hangs 520px ABOVE pad1's top (y1040) and is offset horizontally over GAP2 (boost-only, contested high prize). ONE full-width lethal void band (rim y1260, dark bottomless chasm) runs under the whole span; the three gaps render as separate canyon maws, the outer mesa/far-ledge edges get canyon walls at the arena sides. Gaps use the flagship's validated 580px (islands_void v3 / twin_chasms) — still > the 527px max spring drift and >> the 395px trampoline / 320px bubblegum drift, so still FLIGHT-REQUIRED (Rule A), yet tight enough that a boosted crossing lands with margin on the 680px pads. Bounds are ASYMMETRIC by intent: left blast -720 (mesa gets ~720px of runway = the advantaged safe side), right blast 5620 (~440px past the far ledge = the exposed side, so a knock off the far ledge is a shorter, less-recoverable ring-out). Bottom bound y1920 leaves 712-808px of recovery sky under every surface; top bound -2130 = throne top (520) minus the 2650 clearance so a straight-up self-super arcs back (no routine top self-destruct).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost horizontal reach ~395px off a trampoline, ~320px off bubblegum, ~527px off a spring; normal_boost_max 760px/s crosses a 580px gap in <0.9s @ ~24 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super_boost_impulse 2800 clears everything but dumps the tank). VERIFIED IN-ENGINE: a fuel-full player holding move_right with NO boost off the mesa launched off the edge and fell into GAP1 at x~1605 (~205px past the mesa edge, nowhere near pad1 at x1980) — zero-boost cannot cross; the same player WITH boost carried past x1864 across the gap. Flight is required.
- GAP1 mesa->pad1 (mesa right edge x1400 -> pad1 left edge x1980 = 580px of open void). > 527 (max spring drift; launch surface is the trampoline mesa at ~395 drift). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; a bounce-hop drifts at most ~395px and drops into the void (measured: fell at x~1605). Verb: FLY. (Rule A, >= 560.)
- GAP2 pad1->pad2 (x2660 -> x3240 = 580px over void; the spring throne hangs over it). > 527, >> 320 bubblegum drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED both ways. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- GAP3 pad2->far ledge (x3920 -> x4500 = 580px over void). > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void short of the prize. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- Reaching the FAR LEDGE (and its powerup) requires CHAINING three boosted hops out over the void from the mesa — the prize is only won by committing to flight across the scatter; there is NO bounce route rightward. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the SPRING THRONE (top y520): 520px above pad1's top (y1040) AND offset over GAP2 (a diagonal boosted arc, not a bounce). The best pad bounce is the bubblegum apex 180 -> reaches only y860, 340px short even before the horizontal offset; no spring sits at floor height. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; an under-shot climb drops back to a pad or past it into the void. Verb: FLY. (Rule B, >= 500.)
- SUPER as the committed play: a full super clears any 580px gap or the throne climb in one blast (leap the whole scatter to contest the far powerup, or snipe a rival off a pad into the void) but drains the tank -> the cross-map play, not routine traversal. Verb: FLY+SMASH. (Rule C.)
- RECOVER after being knocked toward the void: the drop from a surface bottom (mesa 1208 / pads 1152/1112 / far ledge 1180) to the bottom blast line (y1920) is 712-808px of open sky over the chasm (>= 650, Rule D) -> a healthy fuelled player knocked off can boost back to a surface (the recovery gamble), while a near-brink dead-on smash or a starved/damaged victim rings out. A knock off a 680px pad (less runway than the 1400 mesa) or off the far ledge (~440px inside the right blast) is a shorter, less-recoverable ring-out than a knock off the wide mesa (~720px runway) -> the asymmetry IS the risk gradient. Verb: FLY.
- Every crossing (three 580px gaps) exceeds even a spring bounce's 527px reach and far exceeds the trampoline/bubblegum drift (395/320), and the throne sits 520px above pad1 (> the 480 spring apex), so NO route across or up the arena exists without the jetpack. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.

SUCCESS CRITERIA (void_is_floor class + per-level asymmetry checks, §L-8): CL1 — >= 12 stages: credited off-screen kills >= 90% and (K1'b) uncredited self-falls <= 12%; a meaningful share of combat (>= 30% of kills) occurs on the RIGHT scatter (kills[].vx > the first gap centre ~1690) — proves the asymmetry pulls players off the safe mesa into the void field. CL2 — no mesa camping: idle_hunt hunts any bot idling on the mesa > 4s. CL3 — flight-required: the right-scatter 580px gaps need a boost >= 9/10 (VERIFIED: zero-boost falls short into the void). VOID READS AS DEATH via the pit_void_rendering treatment (dark cool bottomless gradient + receding dirt canyon walls at each mesa/pad/ledge cliff + under-lip AO + matte hazard-red rim/chevrons along y1260 + falling motes) so the whole right void is unmistakably lethal, not safe green.
